GET only calls requireUser() (any role, incl. PATIENT) then resolves the `x-prescription-ref` header through the unscoped fetchPrescriptionForHandoffScan(prescriptionRef) (prisma.prescription.findUnique by id), returning medication/dosage/instructions/patient name for any prescription. The patient-facing sibling pickup-status uses the patientId-scoped fetchOwnedPrescriptionForHandoffScan, showing this lookup is missing object-level authorization.
